instruction: Create a GRUB entry with a custom root filesystem
output:
cat >> /etc/grub.d/40_custom <<'EOF'
menuentry 'Custom Root FS' {
  linux /vmlinuz root=/dev/sda2 ro
  initrd /initrd.img
}
EOF
update-grub

GRUB: boot a Xen hypervisor
output:
cat >> /etc/grub.d/40_custom <<'EOF'
menuentry 'Xen Hypervisor' {
  multiboot2 /boot/xen.gz dom0_mem=1024M
  module2 /boot/vmlinuz-6.1.0 root=/dev/sda1 ro quiet
  module2 /boot/initrd.img-6.1.0
}
EOF
update-grub
